# unifi_network_port_profile (Resource)

A UniFi switch-port profile (`portconf`, legacy `/rest`) — a reusable port configuration (VLAN behavior, PoE, port security, STP, 802.1X, rate limiting) applied to switch ports.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name.

### Optional

- `autoneg` (Boolean) Auto-negotiate link speed/duplex.
- `dot1x_ctrl` (String) 802.1X control mode (e.g. `auto`, `force_authorized`, `force_unauthorized`, `mac_based`).
- `dot1x_idle_timeout` (Number) 802.1X idle timeout (seconds).
- `egress_rate_limit_enabled` (Boolean) Enable an egress rate limit.
- `egress_rate_limit_kbps` (Number) Egress rate limit in kbps (when enabled).
- `excluded_network_ids` (Set of String) Tagged networks (`unifi_network_network` ids) to exclude when `tagged_vlan_mgmt = custom`.
- `forward` (String) VLAN behavior: `all`, `native` (untagged only), `customize` (native + selected tagged), or `disabled`.
- `full_duplex` (Boolean) Forced full duplex (when `autoneg = false`).
- `isolation` (Boolean) Isolate this port from other isolated ports.
- `lldpmed_enabled` (Boolean) Enable LLDP-MED.
- `multicast_router_mode` (String) Multicast router mode.
- `native_network_id` (String) Untagged/native network (`unifi_network_network` id).
- `op_mode` (String) Port operation mode (e.g. `switch`, `mirror`, `aggregate`).
- `poe_mode` (String) Power over Ethernet: typically `auto`, `pasv24` (passive 24V), `passthrough`, or `off` (varies by switch model).
- `port_keepalive_enabled` (Boolean) Enable port keep-alive.
- `port_security_enabled` (Boolean) Restrict the port to specific MAC addresses.
- `port_security_mac_addresses` (Set of String) Allowed MAC addresses when `port_security_enabled = true`.
- `speed` (Number) Forced link speed in Mbps (when `autoneg = false`).
- `stp_bpdu_guard` (Boolean) Enable BPDU guard.
- `stp_edge_state` (String) STP edge-port state (e.g. `auto`, `enabled`, `disabled`).
- `stp_port_mode` (Boolean) Participate in spanning tree.
- `tagged_vlan_mgmt` (String) Tagged-VLAN handling: `auto`, `block_all`, or `custom` (use `excluded_network_ids`).
- `voice_network_id` (String) Voice VLAN network (`unifi_network_network` id).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
